deepDive.title: Fits the way you already study

workflow.title: Keep your workflow
workflow.body: Keep uploading the same PDFs you always do. No new templates, nothing to relearn.

tutor.title: A tutor that quizzes you
tutor.body: Exam Mode builds practice tests from your own documents, with instant feedback.

search.title: Search by meaning
search.body: Find answers across all your documents, even when you can't remember the exact word.

fileTypes.question: What kind of files can I upload?
fileTypes.answer: Right now we support PDFs of any size. Support for Word documents and presentations is coming soon.

pricing.question: Is it really free?
pricing.answer: {brand} offers a generous free plan that includes document processing and AI notes. We also have a Pro plan for power users.

aiNotes.question: How does the AI work for notes?
aiNotes.answer: We use advanced models that analyze the text you select together with the context of your document to give you accurate, coherent explanations.

images.question: Can I ask about images and formulas?
images.answer: Yes. Select any image, diagram or equation in your PDF and ask about it directly: the AI answers using that image as context.

examMode.question: What is Exam Mode?
examMode.answer: It creates personalized practice exams from your own documents, with a mascot that keeps you company and instant feedback.

security.question: Are my documents secure?
security.answer: Yes, privacy is our priority. Your documents are encrypted and only you can access them and your annotations.

footer.tagline: The AI-powered study platform. Made for students, by students.
